title: Galeazzo Visconti to Angelo Bolano (Alessandria, 15 Oct 1528) and to Francis I (pieve de Locate, 15 June 1529), BnF fr. 3045 f. 28 and fr. 3096 f. 91 (DECODE R4230, R4256)

steps.what: DECODE R4230/R4256 (Non-decrypted); Tomokiyo GL.htm lists both under Visconti's cipher with Lasry's key; no edition found.
Gallica btv1b9060156p view 54 (fr. 3045 f.28) and btv1b9060015d view 94 (fr. 3096 f.91, right half) downloaded in the visconti1528 session.
First passes in the visconti1528 session (fr3045_f28_reading.md, fr3096_f91_reading.md) with the Landriano key: Italian reads ('mal tratamento'); crossed sign = figure 4 (42, 48).
Second pass on fr. 3096 by an agent, glyph by glyph from deskewed crops (fr3096_f91_tokens.txt).
Bare Lambda = doubling mark; far = NTO as well as CHE; rho = F; y = B in bono.
Second pass on fr. 3045 by an agent, glyph by glyph (fr3045_f28_tokens.txt); theta = D and G, q = H.
Retry at 2-3x on l.5, l.15, l.18, l.20; rr = 'nova' tested in three contexts.
fr. 3096 rules applied to fr. 3045: assai, quanto ci è; 715/778 (91.9%).
DECODE metadata fetched: R4230 = fr. 3045 f.28, R4256 = fr. 3096 f.91; clear closes read 'XV' on both images, not 12.
Web search for an edition of either letter: none.

Push pass on fr. 3045 (fr3045_f28_final.md '## Push pass'): sibling y = B and phrase reading give 'come batale perduta, ogniuno voleva andare ale stancie' (l.5-6), 'che obsante ogni mio mal tratamento' (l.20), loro written LO-R-R-O, 'dico che lui proveda' (dotted p = U from sense only, flagged); enhancement and a second web search changed nothing else. 715 -> 741/778 (95.2%); target 1408/1477 (95.3%), read by a thin margin (94.6% on fr. 3045 without the two judgement calls).

outcome.method_basis: Both letters were read with Lasry's key table on Tomokiyo's cryptiana GL.htm, made for fr. 3045 f. 28 and fr. 3034 f. 154, as extended on the Landriano sibling (visconti1528).
outcome.notes: Both letters read: fr. 3096 95.4%, fr. 3045 95.2% after the push pass (94.6% without two judgement calls: doubled-R loro, dotted p = U in lui from sense only). Numbered codes and a few one-off stretches open.
